signin_lead: Connect to the log server with an API token.
signin_token_hint: Issue a Native API token in the web client under Settings › API tokens.
signin_keychain: The token is kept in the system's credential store, never in a file.
signin_rejected: The server refused the saved token. Enter a new one.
signin_error_bad_url: Enter the URL the web client is reached at, starting with https://. ({detail})
signin_error_unauthorized: The server refused the token. It may be revoked, or its user may have no Logbook left.
signin_error_wl2: This is a Wavelog compatible token. Issue a Native API token instead.
signin_error_no_logbook: The token reaches no Logbook. Issue one for the Logbooks you log to.
signin_error_unreachable: Could not reach the server. Check the URL and the network. ({detail})
signin_error_credentials: The token could not be kept in the credential store: {detail}
signin_error_config: The settings file could not be used: {detail}
